cim_eredeti: AI will soon master biology, unleashing new safety risks, Tencent AI chief warns
szoveg_eredeti:
Frontier AI systems could soon be capable of accelerating drug discovery – but also creating new bioweapons and starting the next pandemic

Artificial intelligence models will soon be powerful enough to master biology, presenting both benefits and serious risks, Tencent Holdings’ chief AI scientist and former OpenAI star researcher Vinces Yao Shunyu said during a rare public appearance on Saturday.

“The cyber abilities of [AI] models and soon [the] bio ability of models will reach a threshold where it’s actually possible to do harm,” Yao said at a science symposium co-hosted by the Hong Kong Academy of Sciences and the Future Science Prize.

prioritas.lead_hu: Vinces Yao Shunyu, a Tencent vezető AI-tósa és az OpenAI egykori kutatója szerint a határfedélzeti AI-modell hamarosan felgyorsíthatja a gyógyszerkutatást, de új biológiai fegyverek kockázatát is elhozza.
